verdict.rationale: Airwallex's Spend AI captures receipts and matches them to card transactions without employee input. It also checks receipts for merchant, date, amount and tax details, and syncs accounting data to QuickBooks, Xero and NetSuite. However, AI filling of accounting fields is documented only for bills, not for card spend at the moment it happens. missing for 10: documented category/GL and memo coding on card transactions at time of spend, evidence that coding happens in real time rather than at report/approval, independent or hands-on corroboration of close-readiness.

support.subject: As a finance lead, spend is coded as it happens — merchant, category, memo, receipt — so month-end close is a review, not an archaeology dig

citations.quote: AI captures receipts and matches them to the right card transactions without manual input from employees.
AI checks receipts for required details like date, amount, merchant, and tax information.
Simply attach your bill, then watch AI fill out accounting fields before routing it for approval.
Sync all data and accounting information with QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, and more
